# FFmpeg source code offer

Vocal2Midi distributes a prebuilt FFmpeg 7.1.1 command-line binary
(`ffmpeg.exe`) under the **GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or
later** (LGPL-2.1-or-later).

## Written offer

In accordance with LGPL-2.1 section 6, the maintainers of Vocal2Midi
("Xiantaidu") offer to give any third party, for at least three years from the
date the binary was received, a complete machine-readable copy of the
corresponding source code for the FFmpeg 7.1.1 binary distributed with this
repository.

The corresponding source is the unmodified upstream FFmpeg 7.1.1 release:

- Tarball: <https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.1.tar.xz>
- SHA-256: `733984395e0dbbe5c046abda2dc49a5544e7e0e1e2366bba849222ae9e3a03b1`

together with the build recipe in [`BUILD.md`](BUILD.md) and
`scripts/build_ffmpeg.py` at the repository root. No patches are applied.

## How to request a copy

If you cannot obtain the source from the URL above, open an issue at
<https://github.com/Xiantaidu/Vocal2Midi/issues> titled
"FFmpeg source code request", and include the distribution channel and the
date you received the binary. We will provide a download location for the
source archive, or another mutually agreed delivery method.

## Scope

This offer covers only the FFmpeg source code corresponding to the bundled
binary. It does not cover Vocal2Midi's own code or any third-party component
that is not part of the FFmpeg build.

## No warranty

The source code is provided under the terms of the LGPL-2.1, without warranty
of any kind.
